name: Kleingarten
author: Timo Fricke

sections.description: Make your allotment garden association more lively and connected than ever before! With this extension, you can bring the joy of gardening into the digital age.
sections.installation:
Installing “Kleingarten” can be done either by searching for “Kleingarten” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload’ screen in your WordPress dashboard
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
What is the plugin template for?

This plugin extends WordPress with useful functions for allotment garden associations.

  • Allows members to register user accounts.
  • Introduces Likes for posts.
  • Allows only registered and confirmed members to read private posts.
  • Introduces email notifications for registered members.
